lines.name: Loan Officer (Copperleaf Home Loans)
lines.content: Hi, is this Dale? This is Trent with Copperleaf Home Loans.

lines.name: Loan Officer (Copperleaf Home Loans)
lines.content: Trent, with Copperleaf Home Loans. I'm calling about refinancing your home.
I didn't ask about any refinance.

lines.name: Loan Officer (Copperleaf Home Loans)
lines.content: I understand. Do you currently have a mortgage on your home?
That's none of your business. Take me off your list. Do not call me again.

lines.name: Loan Officer (Copperleaf Home Loans)
lines.content: Totally, I just want to mention we're doing some amazing things right now, folks are cutting their payments by hundreds.
Did you hear me? I said take me off your list.

lines.name: Loan Officer (Copperleaf Home Loans)
lines.content: I hear you, Dale. Just one quick thing, rates are down to around five and three-quarters for people like you.
I don't care. Stop calling me.

lines.name: Loan Officer (Copperleaf Home Loans)
lines.content: Okay, but if you change your mind, it only takes fifteen minutes to apply.
